item.title: WYDOT: ‘No unnecessary travel’ on Teton Pass amid reduced visibility
item.description: WILSON, Wyo. — Heads up, folks. Driving conditions on Teton Pass look particularly challenging. The Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) issued a “no unnecessary travel” advisory for WY22 over Teton Pass at 3:03 p.m. on Friday. The agency also warned of reduced visibility. item.title: Heads up: Head-on collision, vehicle fire reported on Village Road
item.description: WILSON, Wyo. — Emergency page-outs are reporting a head-on collision and vehicle fire on WY390 north of John Dodge Road. Responders are on the scene to fight the fire. Expect traffic delays in the vicinity, per Google Maps. This is a developing story. Buckrail will provide updates as information becomes available.
